title: Master's Appearance
next_chapter_hook: When Mo Xiansheng's figure completely dissipated into the night, the fingers Chen Ji held the Turtle Shell divine artifact with turned faintly pale—What did his master's parting words truly mean? And how should he choose regarding the sacrifice condition for the fourth page of the Tianji Record?

text.content: The night wind whimpered, rustling the tattered window paper of the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji sat alone on the简陋 bed, the blood-stained Jade Pendant in his hand already worn warm from constant stroking. His gaze fell upon the pale waning moon beyond the window, his mind repeatedly replaying Ye Qing's departing silhouette and the eyes Ling Yuan hid in the shadows. The cracks along the Jade Pendant's edge flickered in the moonlight like a wound on the verge of tearing open.

Three days ago at that auction, under the name of 'trash,' he performed a stunning feat—swapping a pseudo elixir for the Taixu Order, and humiliating Xuanwu Sect prodigy Han Lie before the gathered crowd. At that time he had been calm as ice, calculating without miss, but now, alone, Chen Ji felt a bone-deep exhaustion. The weakness from Heavenly Fate consumption had yet to fully recover, and Ling Yuan's chess game had already been played—he must find a way to break the situation.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji sighs softly, tucking the Jade Pendant into his chest) 'Ling Yuan... what kind of game are you setting up?' he murmurs to himself, his voice hoarse, unlike his usual self. The Jade Pendant's cool touch through his thin shirt brings him slight comfort. This is the only proof Ye Qing left upon parting—an artifact proving the secret collusion between the Holy Sect and the Tianqing Sect.

text.content: At that moment, the candle flame in the room suddenly trembles. That flickering light seems suppressed by some formless force, shifting abruptly from bright orange-yellow to ghostly cyan-white. Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply; his fingers have already stealthily reached for the short blade beneath his pillow that never leaves his side. The Servants' Quarters falls into dead silence, even the wind outside the window seeming cut off by something. His intuition screams warnings—a master has silently invaded this space.

dialogue.content: "No need for such tension. If this master wanted to harm you, you would have died a hundred times already." An elderly yet familiar voice resounds from the Void, carrying the tranquility of one who has seen through worldly matters. Chen Ji jerks his head up to see a phantom figure suspended above the candle flame—it is Mo Xiansheng, his long-missing master. Mo Xiansheng's soul form appears even more translucent than their last meeting, as if it might dissipate in the wind at any moment; only those deep, profound eyes remain burning with keen vision.

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppresses the towering waves in his heart, slowly withdrawing his hand from the short blade. His expression undergoes several transformations in that brief instant—from initial astonishment, to subsequent wariness, to deliberately feigned confusion. Acting skills—he has survived in the Tianqing Sect by being the master of deception.

dialogue.content: "Mas... Master?" Chen Ji's voice trembles slightly, his eye sockets appropriately reddening, like a drowning man clutching the last straw. He stumbles to stand, bowing toward Mo Xiansheng's phantom form, his movements carrying genuine excitement and disbelief. "This disciple thought he would never see Master again in this lifetime... Where have you been all these years?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng gazes quietly at this 'timid' disciple, his soul form drifting slightly as he slowly circles Chen Ji. His gaze seems capable of piercing all pretense,直视 the deepest corners of Chen Ji's heart. After a long pause, he lets out a meaningful light laugh: "Fine acting. Had this master not witnessed your display at the auction, I might truly have been deceived by this facade of yours."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's body stiffens for an instant—that brief hesitation speaks volumes. He slowly straightens his spine, the fear and excitement in his expression ebbing like tide water, replaced by a calm so cold it borders on ruthless. "Since Master already knew, why not expose this disciple?" His voice is steady, showing no sign of panic.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's phantom drifts to the window; moonlight passes through his semi-transparent form, casting a blurred patch of light on the floor. "Because you are still useful." His tone is flat, as if stating the most ordinary fact, "Those chosen by the Tianji Record are never coincidence. This master's appearance today is to bestow upon you a stroke of fortune—and to tell you a harsh truth."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's brow furrows slightly, a flash of keen light flickering in his eyes. "Fortune? Does Master refer to... the fourth page of the Tianji Record?" He neither denies possessing the Tianji Record nor asks how Mo Xiansheng learned of it. At this level of the game, concealment has long become meaningless. Mo Xiansheng turns around, his expression grave for the first time: "You are candid indeed. No wonder you are one of the few who has survived the three major sects' oppression."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's attitude runs deeper than before, as if hiding countless secrets. Faced with this master who is both teacher and enigma, a soul guardian, Chen Ji must make a choice—whether to inquire into the truth of the fourth page of the Tianji Record, or first probe Mo Xiansheng's true intentions for this appearance.

choices.description: Directly ask about the unlock condition for the fourth page of the Tianji Record, displaying a thirst for power while probing whether Mo Xiansheng genuinely intends to help.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal Impatience About Tianji Record Progress
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Clue for the Fourth Page
choices.risk_hint: May Cause Mo Xiansheng to Deem You Easily Controllable
choices.process_label: 你决定先获取关键情报

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stares directly into Mo Xiansheng's eyes without the slightest dodge: "This disciple wishes to know, what is the condition for obtaining the fourth page of the Tianji Record?" His tone is calm yet carries unwavering resolve. Mo Xiansheng falls silent for a moment, his phantom wavering slightly, as if weighing how much to reveal. "You are quite direct." He slowly says, "The condition for the fourth page... is sacrifice."

choices.description: Not rushing to inquire for information, but first observing Mo Xiansheng's stance, judging his true purpose for this appearance—whether foe or ally remains uncertain.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Best Timing to Inquire
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Therefore Be Dissatisfied and Hold Back

dialogue.content: Chen Ji does not immediately speak; instead, he steps back slightly, creating a subtle distance from Mo Xiansheng. His gaze sweeps across Mo Xiansheng's phantom soul form before landing on those deep eyes. "This master's appearance today surely isn't merely to bestow fortune upon this disciple?" A meaningful curve appears at the corner of his mouth, "What do you wish to obtain from this disciple?"

choices.text: Hide the Trump Card, Discuss Only the Turtle Shell
choices.description: Deliberately avoid mentioning the Tianji Record, instead bringing up the Turtle Shell divine artifact, observing Mo Xiansheng's reaction to this mysterious treasure to gauge how much he knows.
choices.visible_reward: Probe Mo Xiansheng's Knowledge of the Turtle Shell
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Think You Are Avoiding the Key Issue

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly reaches into his chest, retrieving the Turtle Shell divine artifact he has always kept close to his body. Its pale golden shell glimmers with a ghostly luminescence under the moonlight, as if containing some ancient, mysterious power. "Master, this disciple recently acquired this object, yet has never been able to decipher its mysteries." He holds the Turtle Shell in his palm, yet his eyes are fixed intently on Mo Xiansheng's every expression change, "Does Master recognize this item?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's gaze falls upon that Turtle Shell divine artifact; his eyes, originally calm as still water, suddenly surge with waves. His phantom trembles violently, as if witnessing something unimaginable. "Where did you obtain it?" His voice loses its composure for the first time, carrying an undisguised shock and agitation.

Chen Ji observes Mo Xiansheng's reaction silently; already a calculation forms in his heart. A soul guardian, becoming so unsettled at the sight of one artifact—there must be some unknown connection between the Turtle Shell divine artifact and Mo Xiansheng. He does not rush to answer, instead cradling the Turtle Shell in his palm, letting moonlight flow across its surface.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng takes a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the turmoil within. His gaze shifts from the Turtle Shell to Chen Ji's eyes, as if wanting to see through his very soul. "Do you know that this Turtle Shell and the Tianji Record originated from the same source?" His voice is low and grave, "They both came from the hands of an ancient prophet, containers that prophet used to house the power of Heavenly Fate."

Chen Ji's pupils contract slightly; his heart churns with enormous waves. Same source? His mind races at lightning speed, connecting the known information. The Tianji Record grants him the ability to foresee the future, while the Turtle Shell divine artifact can conceal Heavenly Secrets' aura—if the two were originally one, could that mean... His fingers unconsciously tighten, gripping the Turtle Shell more firmly.

text.content: "The condition for obtaining the fourth page of the Tianji Record is to sacrifice a treasure related to Heavenly Fate." Mo Xiansheng's voice echoes through the silent Servants' Quarters, each word carrying the weight of a thousand jun. His phantom drifts slowly closer to Chen Ji; complex emotions surface on that aged face, "And this Turtle Shell... precisely meets the condition."

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng reveals a cruel truth—the price for obtaining the fourth page is none other than the Turtle Shell divine artifact in his hand that can conceal Heavenly Secrets' aura. Without the Turtle Shell, Chen Ji will be more easily detected when using the Tianji Record; yet if he keeps it, the fourth page can never be unlocked. He must make a choice.

choices.text: Decide to Sacrifice the Turtle Shell
choices.description: The power of the Tianji Record far outweighs the Turtle Shell; to survive in this chaotic world, Chen Ji is willing to pay any price.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Ability to Conceal Heavenly Secrets' Aura
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: More Likely to Be Exposed When Using the Tianji Record
choices.process_label: 你决定牺牲龟壳换取力量

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowers his gaze to the Turtle Shell in his palm; a flash of struggle flickers across his eyes. After a moment, his gaze turns resolute once more. "To grow stronger, any price is worth paying." His voice is terrifyingly calm, as if discussing someone else's affairs. Mo Xiansheng watches him silently; an uninterpretable glint passes through those phantom eyes. "Very well. This master shall guide you through the sacrifice."

choices.text: Refuse the Sacrifice, Keep the Turtle Shell
choices.description: The Turtle Shell is a lifeguard; without it, one is more easily detected by enemies. Better to abandon the fourth page than lose this layer of protection.
choices.visible_reward: Retain the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact

dialogue.content: Chen Ji returns the Turtle Shell to his chest, his movements so gentle as if handling the most precious treasure in the world. "My apologies, Master." His voice is calm yet firm, "This disciple still has people he must protect, truths he must investigate. Before possessing sufficient strength to defend myself, this disciple cannot lose this final barrier." Mo Xiansheng gazes at him for a long moment, finally letting out a sigh: "So be it. This matter need not be rushed."

choices.text: Ask If There Are Other Options
choices.description: Not rushing to decide, first probing whether other paths exist to obtain the fourth page, or other treasures that can be sacrificed.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Therefore Be Dissatisfied and Hold Back

dialogue.content: Chen Ji does not immediately give an answer; instead, he raises his head to stare directly into Mo Xiansheng's eyes. "Master, treasures in this world are not limited to the Turtle Shell alone." His tone is calm yet conceals a blade, "This disciple wishes to know, besides sacrifice, does any other path exist to obtain the fourth page? Even if the price required is greater, this disciple is willing to try." Mo Xiansheng falls silent for a long while before finally speaking: "There is one method, but the price... is heavier than the Turtle Shell."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form begins to grow even more translucent, as if about to dissipate into the wind. He glances at the sky beyond the window, which has begun to lighten, and a meaningful smile curves his lips. "Let us end tonight's discussion here." His voice grows distant, "This master must go. Remember, the more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the stronger fate's lethal backlash grows—with each step forward, you draw nearer to that ending."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji jerks his head up, about to demand answers, but is stopped by Mo Xiansheng's raised hand. That phantom palm passes through his shoulder, carrying a bone-piercing chill. "Some things, their time has not yet come." Mo Xiansheng's form has begun to dissolve, leaving only a fading voice, "Ji'er, when this master took you as disciple all those years ago, it was not coincidence..." Before the words finished, the candle flame abruptly returns to normal; no trace of any anomalous energy fluctuation can be sensed throughout the Servants' Quarters.

text.content: Chen Ji stands frozen, the Turtle Shell divine artifact clutched tightly in his hand. Mo Xiansheng's parting words pierce his heart like a blade. Not coincidence? What does all this mean? Was he chosen from the very beginning? Chosen by whom? The Tianji Record? Or that so-called Eye of Heavenly Dao? Countless questions surge through his mind, yet no one can give him answers. Beyond the window, the sky has begun to lighten; a new day is about to begin.

Chen Ji draws a deep breath, forcibly suppressing all his questions and unease. He walks to the window, letting the cold morning breeze brush across his face, slowly dissipating the night's exhaustion and shock. Whatever Mo Xiansheng's true intentions, whatever secrets lie behind the Tianji Record, he will not retreat. Since fate has pushed him onto this chessboard, he shall be the one who plays—rather than becoming a piece in another's hand. He lowers his gaze to the Turtle Shell divine artifact in his palm; a resolute light flickers in his eyes.

When Ye Qing's figure disappeared into the night, Chen Ji tightly grips the blood-stained Jade Pendant in his hand; an隐隐不安 stirs in his heart—Ling Yuan's chess game has already been played, and who will be the next piece he targets? And now, Mo Xiansheng's sudden appearance and those profound words cast a wild card onto this intricate chessboard capable of overturning everything. Chen Ji knows, from tonight onward, the enemies he faces will be far more terrifying than he ever imagined. And he must be fiercer, more precise, and more merciless than them.
